meals.name: Oatmeal with Berries and Almond Butter
meals.description: Warm rolled oats topped with fresh mixed berries and a drizzle of almond butter for a nourishing breakfast.
instructions: Combine rolled oats and almond milk in a pot over medium heat.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are creamy and liquid is absorbed.
Transfer to a bowl and top with sliced banana, mixed berries, almond butter, and chia seeds.

meals.name: Turkey and Avocado Whole Wheat Wrap
meals.description: A satisfying wrap packed with lean sliced turkey breast, creamy avocado, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Lay the whole wheat tortillas flat on a clean surface.
Spread hummus evenly across each tortilla.
Layer with fresh spinach, sliced turkey breast, avocado, and tomato slices.
Roll the tortillas tightly, slice in half, and serve.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: A protein-rich afternoon snack featuring creamy Greek yogurt sweetened with honey and topped with crunchy walnuts.
instructions: Scoop Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts and fresh blueberries.

meals.name: Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Roasted Asparagus
meals.description: Flaky oven-baked salmon served alongside nutrient-dense quinoa and tender roasted asparagus spears.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit (200 degrees Celsius).
Place salmon and asparagus on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until salmon is cooked through and asparagus is tender.
Serve salmon and asparagus alongside cooked quinoa with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

meals.name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
meals.description: Crisp apple slices paired with natural peanut butter for a simple and energizing evening treat.
instructions: Wash and slice the apple into wedges.
Sprinkle apple slices lightly with cinnamon.
Serve alongside natural peanut butter for dipping.
